name: km-registration-and-tax-clearance
description: Comoros (Union of the Comoros) tax registration and tax clearance documents for tax year 2026, from Finance Law 2026 (Law 25-020/AU), the Amending Finance Law 2024 (Law 24-013/AU) and the 2023 General Tax Code. Covers the fifteen-day registration request after starting activity (LPF L.1, including operators of electronic platforms), the earlier declaration before starting operations and its KMF 500,000 fine (CGI art. 42 bis), the contents of the registration request and the NIF (L.2, L.3), the ten-day notice on sale or closure, the quitus fiscal (one month) and the attestation de regularite fiscale (three calendar months), who must ask for the attestation, and the 15% customs withholding on an importer without one. Use for questions such as: when must a new business in Comoros register for tax, what is a quitus fiscal, how long is a tax clearance certificate valid, what happens at customs without the attestation. Out of scope: company formation, tax rates, Mayotte. Not reviewed by an a
